review_evidence.recommendation: Draft a visual awareness campaign around Al Qassim's palm groves and date farms. Do not promise visits or activities until they are verified.

claims.claim: Three different photographers shared Al Qassim palm and date-farm photographs: a palm tagged Buraydah, a date farm titled Al Bukayriyah, and date palms titled Unayzah.
The photographs show palm trees, a palm grove and mud-brick buildings. None shows visitors or an organised activity.

uncertainties: Flickr views, favourites and comments describe these photographs. They do not measure interest or visitor demand.
Whether any farm accepts visitors is unverified.
The evidence is three photographs, so this is a hypothesis to test rather than a finding.
Promotional coverage of agricultural tourism in Al Qassim has not been researched.
